Project Role : Cloud Operations Administrator
 

Project Role Description : Work with the Service Delivery Manager to perform capacity management, billing/show back operations, and cost optimization activities across multiple cloud environments.

Minimum 

 3 year(s) of experience is required

As a Cloud Operations Administrator, a typical day involves collaborating closely with the Service Delivery Manager to oversee capacity management, ensuring that cloud resources are efficiently allocated and utilized. The role includes managing billing and show back operations to maintain transparency and accuracy in cloud expenditure. Additionally, the position requires continuous efforts in cost optimization across various cloud platforms, balancing performance and budget considerations. title: Threat & Vulnerability Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities 1. Vulnerability Management Conduct vulnerability assessments across networks, servers, endpoints, cloud platforms, and business applications. Perform vulnerability analysis, triage findings, and prioritize remediation based on business risk. Track remediation activities and validate closure of identified vulnerabilities. Maintain vulnerability registers, remediation status, and management reporting. 2. Penetration Testing & Security Assessments Conduct internal and external penetration testing of applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and network environments. Perform security validation of internally developed applications prior to production deployment. Identify security weaknesses and provide actionable remediation recommendations. Support periodic red team and security testing exercises where required. 3. Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) Support and operate the firm's Continuous Threat Exposure Management program. Perform regular attack surface reviews and identify emerging exposure risks. Monitor security advisories, threat intelligence feeds, and relevant CVEs affecting the organization's technology landscape. Recommend preventive and corrective actions to reduce risk exposure. 4. Remediation & Risk Management Work with Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, and Application teams to address identified vulnerabilities. Validate remediation effectiveness and support risk acceptance processes where required. Track compliance with vulnerability remediation SLAs. Escalate critical and overdue findings to management. Qualifications & Experience Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline. 3-5 years of experience in Vulnerability Management, Penetration Testing, Application Security, or Security Assessment roles. Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment tools such as Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, Tenable, or equivalent. Experience performing penetration testing of applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and network environments. Good understanding of AWS, Azure, cloud security concepts, and common cloud vulnerabilities. Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, CVSS scoring, vulnerability prioritization, and remediation methodologies. Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

title: Senior Aws Cloud Engineer
description:
Role Summary The L3 AWS Cloud Engineer will act as the senior technical resource responsible for AWS infrastructure deployment, Infrastructure as Code implementation, complex troubleshooting, automation, production support, and technical guidance for L1/L2 operations. This role requires strong hands-on AWS deployment experience, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification. Role Title 
 L3 AWS Cloud Engineer Experience Required 
 Minimum 7 years in AWS Cloud Work Location 
 Coimbatore Primary Focus 
 AWS service deployment, Infrastructure as Code, automation, production troubleshooting, and technical ownership Mandatory Certification 
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, Terraform Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot AWS cloud infrastructure and services. Develop, maintain, and optimize Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation. Perform hands-on deployment and configuration of AWS services including EC2, VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch, ELB/ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling Groups, EKS/ECS, Route 53, AWS Backup, and Systems Manager. Own L3-level troubleshooting for infrastructure, networking, access, performance, deployment, security, and service availability issues. Provide technical guidance and escalation support to L1 cloud monitoring resources. Implement AWS best practices for security, scalability, availability, resilience, monitoring, and cost optimization. Support cloud deployment automation, environment builds, operational improvements, and migration-related activities. Review and validate Terraform modules, CloudFormation templates, IAM policies, networking configurations, and deployment plans. Participate in incident resolution, root cause analysis, problem management, and preventive action planning. Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment guides, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and SOPs. Coordinate with application, DevOps, infrastructure, network, and security teams for cloud operations and delivery. Ensure adherence to cloud governance, security controls, compliance requirements, naming standards, and tagging policies. 
 Required Skills and Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in AWS cloud engineering, AWS infrastructure operations, or cloud deployment support. Mandatory AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and automation. Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation template development, stack deployment, and troubleshooting. Strong practical knowledge of AWS compute, storage, networking, database, monitoring, backup, and security services. Good understanding of VPC, subnets, routing, NAT Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect basics, Security Groups, NACLs, and DNS. Strong knowledge of IAM roles, policies, permissions, least privilege access, and AWS security best practices. Experience with CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, CloudTrail, and operational monitoring. Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup, restore, scaling, and resilience design patterns in AWS. Ability to independently troubleshoot AWS infrastructure, deployment, access, networking, and performance issues. Experience working in production support and ITIL-based incident/change/problem management environments. 
 Preferred Skills: Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, or similar platforms. Experience with container services such as Amazon ECS or Amazon EKS. Scripting capability using Python, Shell, or PowerShell. Experience with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Service Catalog, or Landing Zone concepts. Knowledge of cost optimization, AWS Trusted Advisor, reserved capacity, rightsizing, and billing analysis. Additional AWS certifications are an advantage. 
 L3 Scope and Ownership: Expected to independently handle complex AWS deployment, automation, and production troubleshooting activities. Expected to review and guide L1/L2 actions for escalated cloud incidents. Expected to own technical documentation, deployment standards, incident RCA inputs, and operational improvement recommendations. Expected to support management and technical teams in maintaining stable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective AWS environments.

Key Skills: AWS Cloud,AWS DevOps,Jenkins,Terraform,Shell Scripting,Ci/Cd,AWS Infrastructure,Kubernetes
